segments.name: Grid
segments.description: Provides power control and system solutions for utilities, industrial and semiconductor manufacturers, and the military.
segments.evidence: Comtrafo is operated and reported as a component of our Grid business segment.

segments.name: Wind
segments.description: Supplies power electronics, control systems and licensed turbine designs to wind turbine manufacturers.
segments.evidence: We supply advanced power electronics and control systems, license our highly engineered wind turbine designs, and provide extensive customer support services to wind turbine manufacturers.

revenueModel.text: Customers including utilities, industrial manufacturers, the military and renewable energy companies pay for power system products, services, spare parts and design licenses.
revenueModel.evidence: We supply advanced power electronics and control systems, license our highly engineered wind turbine designs, and provide extensive customer support services to wind turbine manufacturers.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Comtrafo, a Brazil-based transformer manufacturer, operated as a component of the Grid segment.
changes.evidence: Comtrafo is operated and reported as a component of our Grid business segment.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company acquired NWL through Megatran Industries, operated as a component of the Grid segment.
changes.evidence: Megatran, together with NWL and its other wholly-owned subsidiaries and affiliates, is operated and reported as a component of our Grid business segment.
